question: Can anyone else see this form?
inference: The form is inaccessible by ordinary means
uncertainties: dānai- carries trailing hyphen in source
rna appears as fused negation token
plain_english: Not by Veda, sacrifice, study, nor by gifts, nor by rites, nor by severe austerities can such a form be seen by me in the human world by other than you, O Kuru hero.
